kinds.label: confirm
kinds.about: accepted, done, successful — the good ending

kinds.label: notify
kinds.about: an alert, a message, attention

kinds.label: close
kinds.about: something closing, dismissing, going away

kinds.label: pick
kinds.about: choosing, selecting, marking something

kinds.label: progress
kinds.about: work in progress — loading, processing, streaming

kinds.label: drag
kinds.about: a drag, a scrub, something being moved by hand

kinds.label: open
kinds.about: something opening, expanding, going in

kinds.label: error
kinds.about: rejected, invalid, blocked — the bad ending

kinds.label: media
kinds.about: playing, seeking, recording — the transport

kinds.label: click
kinds.about: a tick or a press — a button, a switch, a short contact

kinds.label: start
kinds.about: starting, playing, going

kinds.label: toggle
kinds.about: a state change — something switched on or off

kinds.label: type
kinds.about: typing, keys, keystrokes

kinds.label: impact
kinds.about: a heavy hit, with weight behind it

kinds.label: stop
kinds.about: stopping, pausing, ending

kinds.label: whoosh
kinds.about: a fast move through air — a whip pan, a fly-in

kinds.label: pop
kinds.about: a short bright pop — round, quick, playful

kinds.label: glitch
kinds.about: a digital break — wrong, broken, too fast

kinds.label: riser
kinds.about: a build that goes somewhere

kinds.label: undo
kinds.about: taking something back

kinds.label: drop
kinds.about: a descending move, usually low

kinds.label: hover
kinds.about: soft attention — a cue that something is there

kinds.label: sweep
kinds.about: a rising or falling move — a build or a drop

kinds.label: other
kinds.about: a sound that does not fit one of the named kinds

kinds.label: tap
kinds.about: a light tap — a fingertip, a small contact

kinds.label: note
kinds.about: a tuned note — a mallet, a pluck, a chime

kinds.label: swish
kinds.about: a light move, softer and quicker than a whoosh

kinds.label: sting
kinds.about: a brand sting — the sound that signs a thing off

kinds.label: hit
kinds.about: a hit that lands on the cut

kinds.label: knock
kinds.about: a knock — wood, metal, a door

kinds.label: shimmer
kinds.about: a bright, airy texture

kinds.label: drip
kinds.about: water, a drop, a leak

kinds.label: shutter
kinds.about: a camera shutter, a mechanical snap

kinds.label: foley
kinds.about: real-world texture — cloth, paper, a hand

kinds.label: zap
kinds.about: electric, a spark, a jump
